newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Central bank again urges investor caution in stock investment in bid seen to cool red-hot bourse
President Lee Teng-hui reviews air force, navy during first-day war games
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Clinton says Taiwan issue cannot be resolved by force; HK handover not to affect U.S. policy towards Taiwan
Employers, employees' group reach initial agreement to raise workers' salary by at least 3 percent in fiscal year 1998
LIBERTY TIMES - Nationalist, Democratic Progressive parties likely to resume talks on dual-leadership government system
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Nationalist Party-run investment firms set eyes on construction shares in the second half of 1997 after earning big money through electronic shares
Council for Economic Planning and Development plans revising law to encourage private sectors to invest in transportation facilities
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Securities and Exchange Commission bans board members of newly listed companies from selling their company shares in at least six months
Interbank rate soars 21-month high to 8.323 pct
